scope: Recovered MSR 150 core/cache query and offset update; new profile is restricted to GenuineIntel Family 6 Model B7 with MSR support. Not a target-machine acceptance certificate.
limits: FSP UPD fields confirm Raptor Lake-S configurable core/ring offsets and runtime undervolt protection, but are not themselves runtime MSR addresses.
MSR command/domain layout is recovered from the original client functions and cross-checked against coreboot; coreboot driver deployment on older models does not certify Raptor Lake-S firmware.
No automatic lock clearing, undervolt-protection bypass, VF-point update, per-core override, or server domain mapping.
All new runtime tests use synthetic firmware; no physical voltage change was attempted.
